off_rating_diff.description: Home minus away fitted team offence rating
off_rating_diff.definition: off_rating_home - off_rating_away, where off_rating_T is team T's coefficient in a weighted ridge fit of goals scored per team-game with team-offence and team-defence one-hots, the opposing goalie's SV%/GAA/starts, shrunk prior-season goals for/against (both clubs, 20-game prior), rest, back-to-back and playoff context; higher = stronger offence
off_rating_diff.source: official NHL API scores + MoneyPuck goalie/skater archives (team goals, goalie form, prior-season goals)
off_rating_diff.lookback: expanding settled history with a 240-day recency half-life; weekly refit at each 7th observed game date
off_rating_diff.aggregation: weighted ridge (alpha 50), sample weight 0.5**(age_days/240); goals-per-game coefficient
off_rating_diff.point_in_time_rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; a game's rating enters puck drop and never sees its own result
off_rating_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN until 200 settled training games and for teams with no prior season; in-model handling (median imputation)

def_rating_diff.description: Home minus away fitted team defence rating
def_rating_diff.definition: def_rating_home - def_rating_away, where def_rating_T is MINUS team T's opponent-dummy coefficient from the same weighted ridge goal model; sign-flipped so higher = better defence (fewer goals conceded), net of the goalie faced and prior-season strength
def_rating_diff.source: official NHL API scores + MoneyPuck goalie/skater archives (team goals, goalie form, prior-season goals)
def_rating_diff.lookback: expanding settled history with a 240-day recency half-life; weekly refit at each 7th observed game date
def_rating_diff.aggregation: weighted ridge (alpha 50), sample weight 0.5**(age_days/240); goals-per-game coefficient
def_rating_diff.point_in_time_rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; never sees the current game
def_rating_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN until 200 settled training games and for teams with no prior season; in-model handling (median imputation)

net_rating_diff.description: Home minus away fitted net team rating
net_rating_diff.definition: net_rating_home - net_rating_away, where net_rating_T = off_rating_T + def_rating_T; equal to off_rating_diff + def_rating_diff
net_rating_diff.source: official NHL API scores + MoneyPuck goalie/skater archives (team goals, goalie form, prior-season goals)
net_rating_diff.lookback: expanding settled history with a 240-day recency half-life; weekly refit at each 7th observed game date
net_rating_diff.aggregation: sum of the offence and defence coefficients from one weighted ridge goal model (alpha 50)
net_rating_diff.point_in_time_rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; never sees the current game
net_rating_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN until 200 settled training games and for teams with no prior season; in-model handling (median imputation)

net_rating_sum.description: Combined fitted net strength of both clubs
net_rating_sum.definition: net_rating_home + net_rating_away, where net_rating_T = off_rating_T + def_rating_T; symmetric in the two sides and identical for both teams in a game
net_rating_sum.source: official NHL API scores + MoneyPuck goalie/skater archives (team goals, goalie form, prior-season goals)
net_rating_sum.lookback: expanding settled history with a 240-day recency half-life; weekly refit at each 7th observed game date
net_rating_sum.aggregation: sum of both clubs' net coefficients from one weighted ridge goal model (alpha 50)
net_rating_sum.point_in_time_rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; never sees the current game
net_rating_sum.missing_value_policy: NaN until 200 settled training games and for teams with no prior season; in-model handling (median imputation)

rest_days_diff.description: Home minus away days since each team's previous game
rest_days_diff.point_in_time_rule: days since the team's own strictly-prior game
rest_days_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN for a team's first game of the window; in-model handling

ewm_net_goals_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net goals per game
ewm_net_goals_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=3).mean() of the team's net goals (for - against) over strictly-prior games
ewm_net_goals_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_net_goals_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ewm_goal_share_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted goal share
ewm_goal_share_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=3).mean() of goals_for / (goals_for + goals_against) over strictly-prior games — possession-neutral scoring strength in [0, 1]
ewm_goal_share_diff.aggregation: per-team EWM of the per-game goal share
ewm_goal_share_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_goal_share_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ga_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing goals allowed per game
ga_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of goals against over strictly-prior games (lower = stingier defense; the diff is home − away)
ga_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

shots_for_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing shots on goal per game
shots_for_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of team shots on goal over strictly-prior games
shots_for_per_game_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (team SOG), falling back to the settled score feed's identical team SOG when a boxscore row is missing
shots_for_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with SOG recorded

shots_against_per_game_diff.description: Home minus away trailing shots against per game
shots_against_per_game_diff.definition: rolling(5).mean() of opponent shots on goal over strictly-prior games (lower = better defensive structure)
shots_against_per_game_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (team SOG), falling back to the settled score feed's identical team SOG when a boxscore row is missing
shots_against_per_game_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with SOG recorded

pp_success_diff.description: Home minus away trailing power-play success rate

pp_success_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN without observed opportunities; zero chances contribute zero counts, missing games contribute neither count

faceoff_win_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games with faceoff data

back_to_back_diff.description: Home minus away back-to-back flag (rest < 1 day)

back_to_back_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when either team has no prior game

nhl_giveaways_pg_ewm_diff.point_in_time_rule: trailing EWM then shift(1) — strictly-prior games only

goalie_sv_pct_diff.description: Home minus away expected-starter rolling save percentage
goalie_sv_pct_diff.definition: season-to-date (rolling-30-start EWM) save percentage of each team's expected starting goalie; home − away. The NHL analog of MLB's SP ERA diff
goalie_sv_pct_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (goalie TOI + decision + shots faced)
goalie_sv_pct_diff.lookback: decaying (halflife=3 starts) over the season's starts
goalie_sv_pct_diff.aggregation: per-goalie EWM of the per-start save fraction
goalie_sv_pct_diff.point_in_time_rule: each goalie's strictly-prior starts only; the expected starter is the highest SEASON-TO-DATE prior-workload AVAILABLE goalie (season-scoped, so a prior-season workhorse cannot be served as tonight's starter) — goalies known unavailable strictly before puck drop (Out/IR/Doubtful from the ESPN snapshot replay, or an announced non-medical leave from the versioned nhl_leave_events.json ledger, replayed as intervals) are removed from the workload vote before it runs, and the fallback follows the same opportunity order over the remaining goalies; every candidate excluded -> honest NaN; starter vote uses team/season workload, prior observed team changes and fresh roster captures strictly before exact puck drop; quality uses only earlier game dates
goalie_sv_pct_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no goalie with a prior start this season (e.g. opening-night unknown starter); never fabricated

goalie_gaa_diff.description: Home minus away expected-starter rolling goals-against average
goalie_gaa_diff.definition: season-to-date (rolling-30-start EWM) GAA of each team's expected starting goalie; home − away. The NHL analog of MLB's SP K/9 diff
goalie_gaa_diff.source: official NHL API boxscores (goalie goals against + TOI)
goalie_gaa_diff.lookback: decaying (halflife=3 starts) over the season's starts
goalie_gaa_diff.aggregation: per-goalie EWM of the per-start goals-against rate (per 60 min)
goalie_gaa_diff.point_in_time_rule: each goalie's strictly-prior starts only; starter vote uses team/season workload, prior observed team changes and fresh roster captures strictly before exact puck drop; quality uses only earlier game dates
goalie_gaa_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when no goalie has a prior start; never fabricated

pl_xpm_away.description: combined even-strength + power-play + penalty-kill + 4v4/3v3/extra attacker all-skater healthy-pool mean raw expected plus-minus per 60, away (C/L/R/D positions rolled up)
pl_xpm_away.definition: unweighted mean of the four position-level pool means (C, L, R, D) of raw_rate_per60 for 5on5+5on4+4on5+other, aggregated over the healthy pool -- the most recent trailing-30-game rating per player whose source game date is strictly earlier than the target date, gated at >=900s prior ice time, with any player on an Out/Injured Reserve/IR/Doubtful interval captured before puck drop REMOVED from the pool before the mean. EVO, PPO, PK and other on-ice xGF/xGA and icetime are summed inside each player-game before the rolling window, so this rate is the ice-weighted combined XPM; no shrinkage is applied. MLB's _LINEUP_AGG_ROSTER shape. No top-N cut: all 18 dressed skaters contribute in hockey. The rating itself is never modified; the flag removes a row, it does not discount a value. diff = home - away.
pl_xpm_away.source: MoneyPuck regular-season skater game-by-game archives (on-ice xGoals pair + icetime) + ESPN timestamped injury status snapshots
pl_xpm_away.lookback: trailing 30 played games per player (combined situations) (game grain); source games within injury_stints.POOL_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 45 of the target date -- a slate whose team ratings all trail that gate (the season opener after the offseason) serves the position prior, matching MLB's LINEUP_POOL_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 10 geometry
pl_xpm_away.aggregation: opportunity-weighted mean of surviving player-level raw rates (NFL snap-share parity): each candidate's weight is his own served prior icetime, applied AFTER the injury exclusion so an absent star's ice leaves the blend with him; sides with zero served weight fall back to the plain mean (counted in the pool audit)
pl_xpm_away.point_in_time_rule: a candidate rating enters a target game's pool only when its source game date is STRICTLY earlier than the target date (date-grain source feeds cannot prove within-day publish ordering), so a target game's own row can never enter its own pool; the injury interval opens only on a captured snapshot timestamp strictly before exact puck drop (Out / Injured Reserve / IR / Doubtful -- never a provider filing or projected return date), and the exclusion is evaluated at the game date, per game.
pl_xpm_away.missing_value_policy: mean of the four position priors (this run's measured all-teams position means) when a side has no pool row; never NaN, never 0 -- 0 would read as deliberately inert
